camel_example: aliyun ada ListAgents --region cn-hangzhou --Q '代码评审' --NextToken 'eyJwYWdlIjoyfQ.example' --PageSize 20 --Scope CUSTOM --PageNumber 1 --CreatorId 'example-user' --MaxResults 20 --RequiredRuntime qwen --Visibility user --version 2026-07-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries agents visible to the current identity by paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前身份可见的 Agent
name: ListAgents

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for cursor-based pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 游标分页的每页数量，范围为 1～100，默认值为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The next page token returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 上一次响应返回的下一页令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The page number for page number-based pagination. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码分页的页码，最小值为 1，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for page number-based pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 页码分页的每页数量，范围为 1～100，默认值为 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters agents by the exact creator ID
parameters.help_zh: 按创建者 ID 精确筛选
parameters.name: creator_id

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Matches the name, display name, or description
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，匹配名称、展示名称或描述
parameters.name: q

parameters.help_en: Filters agents by visibility scope. Valid values: `user` and `tenant`
parameters.help_zh: 按可见范围筛选。可选值为 `user` 和 `tenant`
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The query scope. Valid values: `SYSTEM` and `CUSTOM`
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围。可选值为 `SYSTEM` 和 `CUSTOM`
parameters.name: scope

schema.description_en: The response for querying the agent list
schema.description_zh: 查询 Agent 列表的返回结果

Agents.description_en: The list of agent summaries. For field details, see "Supplementary description of response parameters"
Agents.description_zh: Agent 摘要列表，元素字段参见“返回参数补充说明”

items.description_en: The agent summary object. For field details, see "Supplementary description of response parameters"
items.description_zh: Agent 摘要对象，字段说明参见“返回参数补充说明”
items.example: {"agentId":"agent_00000000000000000000000000000001","name":"code-review-agent","official":false,"displayName":"CR 代码评审 Agent","description":"分析代码变更并生成 CR 评审意见","tools":[{"mcpServerName":"code-repository-mcp"},{"connectorName":"code-review-data"}],"skills":[{"name":"code-review"}],"model":[{"name":"base","default":true},{"name":"base"},{"name":"base","settings":{"thinking":false,"topK":5}}]}

MaxResults.description_en: The actual cursor-based pagination size used
MaxResults.description_zh: 实际使用的游标分页大小

NextToken.description_en: The next page token. An empty string is returned if there is no next page
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页令牌，没有下一页时返回空字符串

PageSize.description_en: The current page size for page number-based pagination

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查

Total.description_en: The total number of agents that match the filter conditions
Total.description_zh: 符合条件的 Agent 总数
